Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) Cases Reported in India

Five cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) have been reported across India, with Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan recording cases. https://t.co/BEWLJ0Xjfv
